description: The number of 1s in the first n period-doubling bits, from index 0 through n-1. The first 8 bits have three 1s, and the first 100 bits have 33. n runs from 0 to 999999999999999. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/period-double-sum
